title: How to Showcase Impact and Metrics on Your Resume (Tips from a Recruiter)
description:
Ever stuck on how to articulate your impact of past work experience?

When it comes to showcasing your value to potential employers, highlighting your impact is crucial. Join Leah Dillon, Teal's Recruiter, as we break down the process step-by-step using Teal's Resume Builder.

 In this video, you'll discover:

The importance of metrics on your resume and how they differentiate you from other candidates.
How to take a generic job duty and turn it into a powerful achievement statement that quantifies your impact.
Utilizing tools, like Teal's Resume Builder,  to simplify the resume crafting process and emphasize your metrics-driven accomplishments.

https://www.tealhq.com/post/quantify-your-resume/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=organic_video&utm_campaign=resume_mistakes&utm_content=vid_description_1

Learn this in-depth analysis from a recruiter 

Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, learning to articulate metrics impact is a game-changer.

Ready to supercharge your resume with quantifiable achievements? 

Hit that "Like" button, subscribe to our channel, and let's get started on your journey to a more impactful resume that impresses recruiters and potential employers alike.

Need to skip around?

00:16 | Why are hiring managers looking for "impact"?
00:45 | How to think about your impact and metrics
02:21 | Breaking down our improved resume achievement
